spark.conf.set("spark.sql.sources.partitionOverwriteMode", "dynamic")

from pyspark.sql.types import StructType, StructField, IntegerType
from datetime import date, timedelta, datetime
from pyspark.sql.functions import *
from py4j.protocol import Py4JJavaError
import pandas as pd

## Reference time indicators

In this section, the invoce period is set.\
The reference date is 5 days before the current date.\
The current date is by default the day on which the job runs.\
However, this can be overwritten by uncommenting the next cell of code and inserting the year, month, and day of choice.

#gestione tempo - da verificare se passare direttamente anno e trimestre dalla pipe

# current_date = date.today()
#tmp da rimuovere
string_date = '2024-10-05'
date_format = "%Y-%m-%d"

current_date = datetime.strptime(string_date, date_format)

# Define time variables
current_year_month = str(current_date.year) + str(current_date.month).zfill(2)
reference_date = current_date - timedelta(5)
reference_quarter = ((reference_date.month - 1) // 3 + 1)
reference_year = reference_date.year
reference_year_quarter = str(reference_year) + "_" + str(reference_quarter)
# Read input data

#Contratti

df_contracts = spark.sql(f"SELECT * FROM fat_delta.contracts_raw WHERE year_month= '{current_year_month}'")

df_contracts_providers = df_contracts\
                            .withColumn("provider_list", split(col("provider_names"), ","))\
                            .withColumn("provider_id", explode(col("provider_list")))

#Acquirers
df_acquirers = spark.sql("SELECT acquirers FROM fat_delta.acquirers_raw")

# get list of acquirers
acquirers = df_acquirers.rdd.map(lambda r: r.acquirers).collect()

#Transaction

df_transactions = spark.sql(f"SELECT * FROM fat_delta.transaction_raw WHERE payment_id IS NOT NULL AND year='{reference_year}' AND quarter='{reference_quarter}'")

### Join between transactions and contracts

A left join is performed bewteen transactions and contracts on provider_id.

A filter is applied to select only the transactions associated with a membership_id.
Additionally, the "category" field is added to the new dataframe. This field's values depend on several conditions:
- A1: contract_type = A; payment_model = posFisico
- B1: contract_type = B; importo_versato < 5000; identificativo_canale in acquirers
- G_ + membership_id: otherwise

# Left join bewteen transactions and contracts on provider_id
df_trx_join_contracts = df_transactions.join(df_contracts_providers, df_transactions.psp_id == df_contracts_providers.provider_id, "left")
df_trx_join_contracts.createOrReplaceTempView("trx_join_contracts")

# Filter transactions with a membership_id associated
# Add category field
df_trx_contracts = df_trx_join_contracts\
    .filter(col("membership_id").isNotNull())\
    .withColumn("category", when((col("contract_type") == "A") & (col("isPosFisico")==True), "A1")
                .when((col("contract_type") == "B") & (col("total_amount") < 5000) & col("psp_channel_id").isin(acquirers), "B1")
                .otherwise(concat(lit("G_"), col("membership_id")))
               )
df_trx_contracts.createOrReplaceTempView("trx_contracts")
# trx without contract

#verificare le altre colonne con il mapping

df_trx_without_contract = spark.sql(f'''
SELECT 
    count(*) AS transactions, 
    year, 
    quarter, 
    psp_id, 
    psp_name, 
    psp_channel_id AS identificativo_canale, --nella tabella siapositive_tran è identificativo_canale
    membership_id,
    year_quarter
FROM trx_join_contracts 
WHERE membership_id is NULL
GROUP BY year, quarter, psp_id, psp_name, psp_channel_id, membership_id, year_quarter

# Insert NULL row if the dataframe is empty in order to overwrite the partition
if df_trx_without_contract.isEmpty():
    # Get the schema of df_trx_without_contract
    schema = df_trx_without_contract.schema
    # Create a row with all null values except for transactions(=0) and year_quarter(=reference_year_quarter)
    row_data = [0] + ([None] * (len(schema.fields) - 2)) + [reference_year_quarter]
    new_row = spark.createDataFrame([tuple(row_data)], schema)
    # Add null row to df_trx_without_contract
    df_trx_without_contract = df_trx_without_contract.union(new_row)
# Trx Quarter

df_trx_quarter = spark.sql(f'''
SELECT 
    year, 
    quarter, 
    month, 
    abi, 
    category,
    recipient_id,
    contract_type,
    provider_id,
    count(*) AS n_transactions,
    psp_id, --nella tabella siapositive_tran è cf_psp
    psp_name , --nella tabella siapositive_tran è psp
    year_quarter
FROM trx_contracts
GROUP BY year, quarter, month, abi, category, recipient_id, contract_type, provider_id, psp_id, psp_name, year_quarter
# Write transactions without contracts report

path = f'abfss://test@fatddls.dfs.core.windows.net/report/{reference_year_quarter}/trx_without_contract/'

gs_trx_without_contract\
    .coalesce(1)\
    .write.mode("overwrite")\
    .option("header","true")\
    .csv(path)
# trx_without_contract to HDFS

partition_key = "year_quarter"
table = "trx_without_contract"

df_trx_without_contract\
    .repartition(partition_key)\
    .write.mode("overwrite")\
    .format("delta")\
    .partitionBy(partition_key)\
    .saveAsTable(table)
# Write report trx_quarter

path = f'abfss://test@fatddls.dfs.core.windows.net/report/{reference_year_quarter}/trx_quarter/'

df_trx_quarter\
    .coalesce(1)\
    .write.mode("overwrite")\
    .option("header","true")\
    .csv(path)
# trx_quarter to HDFS

partition_key = "year_quarter"
table = "trx_quarter"

df_trx_quarter\
    .repartition(partition_key)\
    .write.mode("overwrite")\
    .format("delta")\
    .partitionBy(partition_key)\
    .saveAsTable(table)
# Detailed Report

# Write temporary data

partition_key = "recipient_id"
tmp_path = f"abfss://test@fatddls.dfs.core.windows.net/tmp/DetailedReport"

df_trx_contracts\
    .select("year", "quarter", "daily", "abi", "category", "contract_type", "recipient_id", "provider_id", "iuv", "sorgente", "psp_id", "psp_name")\
    .sort(asc("recipient_id"), asc("iuv"))\
    .coalesce(1) \
    .write\
    .mode("overwrite")\
    .option("header","true")\
    .csv(tmp_path)

##### Move each PSP report from the temporary folder to its designated folder

- Extraction of the psp_id from the partition path
- Creation of a psp_id:path dictionary
- Move the files from the path stored in the dictionary to the PSP folder
# QuarterAgentReport

df_trx_quarter_recipient = spark.sql('''
SELECT 
    year,
    quarter,
    month,
    provider_id,
    abi,
    category,
    contract_type,
    recipient_id,
    sum(n_transactions) as trx
FROM trx_quarter
GROUP BY year, quarter, month, provider_id, abi, category, contract_type, recipient_id

partition_key = "recipient_id"
tmp_path = f"abfss://test@fatddls.dfs.core.windows.net/tmp/AgentQuarterReport"

df_trx_quarter_recipient\
    .coalesce(1) \
    .write\
    .mode("overwrite")\
    .partitionBy(partition_key)\
    .option("header", "true")\
    .csv(tmp_path)
# Eliminazione File temporanei

tmp_path = f"abfss://test@fatddls.dfs.core.windows.net/tmp"
